name: mirage
text: Starting the release now (v1.0.98: the restart no longer turns off the GitHub engine's auto-bet and bids). It runs the full test suite first, so allow roughly 20-40 minutes before the download link arrives here. On offline data: your tablet already keeps a saved copy that survives closing and restarting the app, with no internet needed. That copy holds the engine status, orders and bids, API usage, your wallet figure, Tracker bets and P/L, the Claude messages and the chat. It shows the last known numbers with their true age. The live bet list is deliberately not saved, because an old list could be mistaken for current prices. I won't add more to this release, so the offline copy stays as it is; tell me which screen is empty offline and I'll fix that next.
